items.title: Constructible subsets pull back along a quasi-compact open immersion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that constructible subsets of an open subspace pull back to constructible subsets of the ambient space when the immersion is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2842-2849, label lemma-quasi-compact-open-immersion-constructible-inverse-image). The proof (source lines 2851-2861) transfers retrocompactness across the quasi-compact immersion, identifies the pieces with differences of ambient opens and concludes by taking finite unions (proof lines 2851-2861). The transfer of retrocompactness is the content. H3.
